command: python bench/run.py --name m07-step4-mtp --gpu 0 --model unsloth/Qwen3.8-27B-GGUF@4ca720788d1e/Qwen3.8-27B-UD-Q4_K_M.gguf --lock plans/unsloth/Qwen3.8-27B-GGUF/Qwen3.8-27B-UD-Q4_K_M@322e194ff79741c7/rtx-4090/cu130-torch2.11/4.lock --backends holon holon@a256 holon@a512 --arm a256=--chunk-with-decode 256 --arm a512=--chunk-with-decode 512 --rounds 2 --corpus judge/prompts/v1-qwen3_5.jsonl --traces bench/traces/agent.jsonl bench/traces/long_prompt.jsonl --evidence-dir rtx-5090
method: In-process engines driven by bench/driver.py, one scheduling step per call; client-side timestamps taken when a step returns a token. TTFT = first token - release (arrival, or previous turn's last token + gap); TPOT = (last - first) / (tokens - 1) per request; throughput = output tokens / (last token - first release). Decode steps = steps at peak batch that return no first token; decode tok/s = their tokens / their wall time. Max gap = a request's largest time between two deliveries after its first token. Paired TTFT = the median over (round, session, turn) of TTFT / the first backend's TTFT in the same round. CPU ms/step = time.process_time() delta around step() on those steps, measured with --blocking-sync (CUDA primary context in blocking-sync mode and torch events created blocking, so waiting for the GPU sleeps and is not counted). Greedy, ignore_eos, fixed output lengths; warmup on the same shapes with other prompt tokens, excluded. HTTP backends (llamaserver, holon_http; bench/backends/http.py): streamed requests, a token timestamped when its chunk arrives; their 'steps' are client polls, so decode tok/s and CPU ms/step do not apply to them.

matched.samplers: top_k / top_p / min_p off on every engine
